title: Geometric Categories and Sheaves on Topoi
summary: We introduce the notion of a geometric $(\infty,1)$-category, the protopyical example of which is an $(\infty,1)$-topos. We study (hyper)sheaves on geometric $(\infty,1)$-categories, proving that these are characterized by a form of Čech (hyper)descent. As an application we study (hyper)sheaves on $(n,1)$-topoi for all $n\in \mathbf{Z}_{\geq 1}\cup \{\infty\}$, and prove that the effective epimorphism topology on an $(n,1)$-topos $\mathcal{X}$ may be identified as the canonical topology on $\mathcal{X}$.
